dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Nara Varuna cooks many many dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Brothers afraid of fire, however. They didn't see the cooking clearly, and started cooking training after Nara Varuna left.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is Golden Nara, too. Nara {NICKNAME} must know how to cook many many dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Arachatora, Arasaka, Arapas, and Araphala will take a closer look this time, and learn about Nara cooking.
